name: Demo tenant auth fix — provision opal-partner-demo (JWT firmRole claims)
description: Andrew-direct GO 2026-06-03 (relayed 0.6.0). The demo login renders an EMPTY AdvisorIntelligence because the partner-firm JWT claims (firmRole/advisorKey/advisorName/advisorRole) are minted at LOGIN by the auth-handler Lambda (infra/aws/opalinvest_dev/lambda/auth-handler/, Cognito pre-token-gen) reading opal-partner-{firmId} (resolver infra/aws/lambda/lib/partner/tableName.ts) -- and opal-partner-demo NEVER EXISTED. register_demo_tenant.py only provisioned opal-users-v2 (FIRM#demo + user), never the partner entry (assumed partner users carry no claims). So demo login -> firmRole=null -> empty AdvisorIntelligence. Broke when firmRole became REQUIRED (Peter-era tightening; IDENTICAL class to the 6-02 Inflection incident 0.7.0 fixed). Demo DATA is 100% intact (opal-data-demo 9,282 objs/169 advisors fresh 5-27; FIRM#demo->bucket resolves; USER#demo@demo.test exists) -- this is purely the auth/claims provisioning gap. Andrew confirmed the in-pattern fix (partner-demo table) is 'easiest way'. Demo is opal-gated (internal opal users already see all firms incl demo per portal firmAccess.ts:79; the partner table covers the demo login + whitelisted externals). NOT on-fire. Distinct from ADVI_DEMOV1 (the demo DATASET clone, COMPLETE) -- this is the demo ACCESS/auth layer.
